newsitem.title: MEXICO: Autrey sees 6 to 8 pct rise in 1996 sales.
newsitem.headline: Autrey sees 6 to 8 pct rise in 1996 sales.

text.p: Mexican pharmaceutical company Grupo Casa Autrey said on Friday that it expects to end 1996 with an increase in sales of between six percent and eight percent over 1995.

"Autrey's total sales will show an increase of between six and eight percent in real terms at the close of the year," Javier Sanchez, the firm's director of investor relations, told Reuters in a telephone interview. Autrey posted a 6.6 percent increase in sales in 1995 over the previous year.
Sales volumes this year are showing little increase, but sales revenue should be higher because of a 7.2 percent price increase.
"There could be another (price) increase of at least three percent" before the end of the year, he said.
Autrey's net profit margin would grow by 3.5 percent this year and operating margin between 4.2 percent and 4.3 percent.

In addition, Sanchez said Autrey would boost its paper business with greater distribution of office products to large companies. Paper could grow to represent four percent of Autrey's sales from less than one percent now.
